name: kea-mcp
description: Inspect and manage ISC Kea through direct daemon APIs or the legacy Control Agent using a locally installed MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect a local kea-mcp binary to your Kea APIs. Supports direct daemon and Control Agent deployments, TLS, Basic authentication, and configurable read-only access. Install the binary on PATH and configure your own Kea endpoints before use.
interface.defaultPrompt: Discover the available Kea commands and check the status and version of each configured service.
